title: glslkit source map
description: Serialized form of Glslkit::SourceMap (segment-based output-line -> (original file, original line) mapping). This is a separate contract from reflection-v1.json: it is embedded independently by consumers that need to resolve compile/link error locations back to original source files (e.g. glslkit-webgl), and is not part of the reflection manifest.

version.description: Stays 1 while this schema is unreleased/unpublished, since there is no compatibility to preserve yet. Bump to 2 the first time a required field is added after the schema is published.

files.description: Canonical paths, indexed by position. Referenced by segments[*][1] (file_index).

segments.description: Each entry is [output_line, file_index, source_line], describing a half-open interval starting at output_line that maps 1:1 to source_line onward in files[file_index], until the next segment (or end of output). MUST be sorted by output_line ascending: consumers resolve via binary search and unsorted input produces incorrect (but not exception-raising) results.
